description: This file implements a header inclusion and dependency checker for a build system, analyzing include relationships, dependency chains, and access permissions between build targets.

classes.name: PublicGeneratedPair
classes.description: A helper struct indicating whether a file is public and/or generated.

methods.name: CreatePersistentRange
methods.description: Creates a persistent copy of an InputFile for error reporting.

methods.name: GetDependencyChainPublicError
methods.description: Generates an error message for invalid dependency chains involving private headers.

methods.name: TargetLabelsMatchExceptToolchain
methods.description: Checks if two targets have the same label ignoring toolchain differences.

methods.name: FriendMatches
methods.description: Checks if a target includes another as a friend based on label patterns.

methods.name: HeaderChecker::Run
methods.description: Runs the header inclusion check on specified targets.

methods.name: HeaderChecker::RunCheckOverFiles
methods.description: Distributes file checks across worker threads.

methods.name: HeaderChecker::DoWork
methods.description: Performs header checks on a single file.

methods.name: HeaderChecker::AddTargetToFileMap
methods.description: Adds target's source files and headers to the internal file map with visibility info.

methods.name: HeaderChecker::IsFileInOuputDir
methods.description: Checks if a file is within the build output directory.

methods.name: HeaderChecker::SourceFileForInclude
methods.description: Resolves an include string to a source file, considering include directories.

methods.name: HeaderChecker::CheckFile
methods.description: Checks a source file for include correctness and dependency rules.

methods.name: HeaderChecker::CheckInclude
methods.description: Validates that an included header is accessible according to dependency rules.

methods.name: HeaderChecker::IsDependencyOf
methods.description: Determines if one target depends on another, optionally finding the shortest chain.

methods.name: HeaderChecker::MakeUnreachableError
methods.description: Creates an error for headers not reachable via dependencies.
